story.what_it_is: A page tests which storage tools your browser supports, such as localStorage, IndexedDB and old add-ons.
story.for_you: You never see it. The page tries each storage type, then picks one that works. It also learns a bit about your browser and any privacy settings.
story.for_makers: Makers use it so sites do not break when a browser blocks storage. The pattern of what works also helps tell browsers and privacy modes apart, which fingerprinting scripts like.

use_cases.example: A browser game tests if it can save progress, and warns you if private mode blocks it.
A store tests cookies and storage before it builds your cart, and shows a warning if they are off.
A fraud service notes that a browser says it supports old Internet Explorer storage tricks, which is a sign of a faked identity.
A fingerprint script builds a profile from which storage tools work and which fail.
A site checks if storage works so it can choose between cookies and a fallback for counting visits.
A web app falls back to a server copy if local storage is off.
